metadata.title: Robert Karr's Second Quarter 2026 Move: Exiting Wix.com Ltd at a -6.67% Portfolio Impact

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Joho Capital's Founder Trims Tech Exposure While Boosting Industrial and Consumer Stakes
Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio), the founder of Joho Capital and a prominent member of the "Tiger Cub" cohort, recently submitted his 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026. Having honed his skills under the legendary Julian Robertson at Tiger Management (Trades, Portfolio), where he specialized in Asian equities, Karr has long favored a concentrated, low-turnover approach. His philosophy centers on a simplistic investment strategy, focusing on a small number of long-term holdings to facilitate deeper research and conviction. This quarter, his actions reflect a notable shift, with the complete liquidation of a significant tech position and strategic increases in other key areas.
Summary of New Buy
Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio) added a total of 1 stock to his portfolio during the quarter, marking a new entry:
-
The most significant addition was PayPay Corp (NASDAQ:PAYP), with 961,608 shares acquired. This new position accounts for 2.99% of the portfolio, with a total value of $13.78 million.
Key Position Increases
Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio) also increased his stakes in a total of 3 stocks, with the most notable changes being:
-
The most notable increase was Hubbell Inc (NYSE:HUBB), with an additional 37,100 shares, bringing the total to 61,000 shares. This adjustment represents a significant 155.23% increase in share count, a 4.21% impact on the current portfolio, and a total value of $31.92 million.
-
The second largest increase was Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN), with an additional 79,800 shares, bringing the total to 346,600 shares. This adjustment represents a 29.91% increase in share count, with a total value of $82.61 million.
Summary of Sold Out
Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio) completely exited 1 holding in the second quarter of 2026, as detailed below:
-
Wix.com Ltd (NASDAQ:WIX): Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio) sold all 276,335 shares, resulting in a -6.67% impact on the portfolio. This move signifies a decisive exit from the cloud-based development platform provider.
Key Position Reduces
Robert Karr (Trades, Portfolio) also reduced his position in 2 stocks. The most significant changes include:
-
Reduced Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 21,300 shares, resulting in a -6.91% decrease in shares and a -2.11% impact on the portfolio. The stock traded at an average price of $404.05 during the quarter and has returned 21.26% over the past 3 months and 2.89% year-to-date.
-
Reduced Walmart Inc (NASDAQ:WMT) by 28,200 shares, resulting in a -23.53% reduction in shares and a -0.94% impact on the portfolio. The stock traded at an average price of $124.14 during the quarter and has returned -12.98% over the past 3 months and 3.87% year-to-date.
